files.content:
backend:
  image:
    repository: incident-replay/backend
    tag: latest
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

  service:
    type: ClusterIP

  storage:
    enabled: false
    type: pvc  # pvc or emptyDir
    size: 1Gi

frontend:
  image:
    repository: incident-replay/frontend
    tag: latest
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent

  service:
    type: ClusterIP

ingress:
  enabled: false
  annotations: {}
  hosts:
    - host: chart-example.local
      paths:
        - path: /
          pathType: ImplementationSpecific
  tls: []

{{- if .Values.backend.storage.enabled -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "incident-replay.fullname" . }}-backend-pvc
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "incident-replay.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.backend.storage.size | quote }}
  storageClassName: ""
{{- end -}}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "incident-replay.fullname" . }}-backend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "incident-replay.name" . }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "incident-replay.name" . }}
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "incident-replay.name" . }}
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: backend
          image: "{{ .Values.backend.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.backend.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.backend.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 5
          volumeMounts:
            {{- if .Values.backend.storage.enabled }}
            - name: backend-storage
              mountPath: /data
            {{- end }}
      volumes:
        {{- if .Values.backend.storage.enabled }}
        - name: backend-storage
          {{- if eq .Values.backend.storage.type "pvc" }}
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: {{ include "incident-replay.fullname" . }}-backend-pvc
          {{- else if eq .Values.backend.storage.type "emptyDir" }}
          emptyDir: {}
          {{- end }}
        {{- end }}
